title: Unknown Crate Number
description: Someone typos a shipment id into the bulk-approve box. The API needs to report that one id as not found without pretending the whole request failed.
successCondition: POST /api/admin/shipments/bulk as admin with action "approve" and shipmentIds set to a single made-up id (e.g. a random UUID that was never created) returns 200 with succeeded 0, failed 1, and results[0] has success false and error "Shipment not found".
hints: This is a 200 response with a per-item failure, not a 404 — the endpoint never fails the whole request over one bad id.
Any string that doesn't match a real shipment's id works; it doesn't need to be a well-formed UUID to prove the not-found path.
